description: Reading the room's member list with real names and groups, including an incomplete read, and a leave inferred from the list.
grounding: v1 memory userlist-ownerdraw: the Camfrog participant list is owner-drawn (LVS_OWNERDATA), so names are captured from WM_DRAWITEM/DrawTextW per row; group headers ('MEMBERS 3', 'LURKERS 7') give on-cam vs off-cam; rows below the fold only paint when paged into view, and 'blank' counts rows that stayed nameless. Names can carry a badge suffix like 'name (Pop)'. The 0x41 packet gives login + display; the list gives what the room shows. v1 has no explicit leave packet, so leaves are inferred from list diffs.

frames.note: One row never painted, so complete=false and count > members.length.
neon_newt was in the previous list and is gone from this one.
